content.text:
The Schependomlaan model has 100 rooms spread over four storeys. No storey has rooms in the foundation or roof levels.

| Storey | Rooms |
|---|---|
| 00 begane grond (ground floor) | 32 |
| 01 eerste verdieping (first floor) | 29 |
| 02 tweede verdieping (second floor) | 20 |
| 03 derde verdieping (third floor) | 19 |

The graph is saved as analysis `ask-rooms-per-storey`. Reload the studio to see it in the picker. It reads the IFC space entities from the entity text view, joins each to its direct containing storey, counts per storey, and sorts by count descending. Every space had a storey, so no "unassigned" row appears.

This database is a Building Open Schema (BOS) export without typed category tables, so the graph uses the generic entity and storey views rather than a space table. The model has six storeys in total. The two not listed, the foundation level and a top level, contain no rooms.
